description: Lists a page of AdSense links for a Google Analytics property. Use the returned next-page token to retrieve additional pages.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing AdSenseLinks on a Google Analytics property.

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of results to return. Must be between 1 and 200. Defaults to 50.
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. Token for retrieving the next page of results.
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. Resource name of the property. Format: properties/{propertyId} (e.g., properties/1234).
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: ListAdsenseLinksRequest

name: list_adsense_links

adClientCode.description: Immutable. The AdSense ad client code that the Google Analytics property is linked to. Example: ca-pub-1234567890.
adClientCode.title: Ad Client Code

name.description: Output only. Resource name of the link. Format: properties/{propertyId}/adSenseLinks/{linkId}.
name.title: Name

nextPageToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results, if any.
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token
